sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Siri = 'S' (Siryanci, Kankane Siri, c. 3,000 speakers, Ningi, one illiterate main informant, p. 3). Sec. 2 'The phonetic inventory' p. 5 (group-level): 'As for tones, usually three levels and a falling were heard in the recordings and a number of minimal pairs of monosyllables confirmed, but it would have been highly impressionistic to have included any tonal markings in the present work.' Wordlist is unmarked for tone.
